description: This file defines an in-memory secret manager class for testing purposes, with methods to read, write, and delete secrets asynchronously and synchronously. It extends a custom secret manager interface and includes logging and print statements for tracing.

classes.name: InMemorySecretManager
classes.description: A custom secret manager that stores secrets in memory for testing purposes, supporting asynchronous and synchronous read/write/delete operations.
